judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), the specification file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`). It never modified `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`, so no input validation actually happens and the test suite fails. Furthermore, the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely missing. Even the tests that were written were placed in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` rather than `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as specified by the acceptance criteria.
